decisions: Candidate order comma, semicolon, tab, pipe breaks ties; an inconsistent widest candidate falls back to comma. A TSV name prefers a consistent tab reading with at least two fields.
Delimiter and encoding are stored in the column profile and pinned table selection. Stored selections without a delimiter remain comma readings, including evidence read-back.

Full UTF-8 validation precedes streamed profiling; a late invalid byte selects Windows-1252 for the entire original. A private temporary byte copy is removed after the read; pinned windows and evidence stream without that copy.
UTF-16 BOMs work in whole-file reads. The byte-window reader refuses UTF-16 explicitly before publishing a window. Original bytes, ranges and range hashes are unchanged.
